from pathlib import Path
import psycopg,pytest,json
from agent_guard.ledger.migrate import apply_migrations,DEFAULT_MIGRATIONS_DIR,MigrationError
from agent_guard.ledger.service import ExecutionLedger
from agent_guard.ledger.provisioning import revoke_grant
from tests.fixtures.state import build_tree
from tests.fixtures.isolation import create_scratch_database,drop_scratch_database
from tests.integration.test_migrations import _snapshot_business_tables
pytest_plugins=['tests.integration.conftest']
def registry(dsn):
 with psycopg.connect(dsn) as c:return c.execute('SELECT * FROM ag_schema_migrations ORDER BY version').fetchall()
@pytest.mark.parametrize('base',['001','003'])
@pytest.mark.parametrize('legal',[True,False])
def test_nonzero_seven_tables_and_complete_registry(namespace,tmp_path,base,legal):
 scratch=create_scratch_database(namespace.base_dsn);initial=tmp_path/'initial';initial.mkdir()
 try:
  for p in DEFAULT_MIGRATIONS_DIR.glob('*.sql'):
   if p.name[:3]<=base:(initial/p.name).write_bytes(p.read_bytes())
  with psycopg.connect(scratch.dsn) as c:apply_migrations(c,initial)
  with psycopg.connect(scratch.dsn) as c:tree=build_tree(c)
  ExecutionLedger(scratch.dsn).accept(tree.invocation(),tree.cost(amount_fen=70000))
  with psycopg.connect(scratch.dsn) as c:
   revoke_grant(c,tree.root_id)
   if not legal and base=='001':
    c.execute("INSERT INTO ag_grants (grant_id,parent_grant_id,root_grant_id,tenant_id,task_id,subject,holder_client_id,holder_kid,depth,not_before,expires_at,amount_limit,call_limit) SELECT 'duplicate-root',NULL,'duplicate-root',tenant_id,task_id,subject,holder_client_id,holder_kid,0,not_before,expires_at,amount_limit,call_limit FROM ag_grants WHERE grant_id=%s",(tree.root_id,))
   if not legal and base=='003':c.execute("UPDATE ag_schema_migrations SET checksum='invalid-review-owned' WHERE version='003'")
  before=_snapshot_business_tables(scratch.dsn);reg=registry(scratch.dsn);assert all(before.values())
  if legal:
   with psycopg.connect(scratch.dsn) as c:applied=apply_migrations(c)
   assert applied==[f"{i:03}" for i in range(int(base)+1,7)];assert registry(scratch.dsn)[:int(base)]==reg
   reg_after=registry(scratch.dsn)
   with psycopg.connect(scratch.dsn) as c:assert apply_migrations(c)==[]
   assert registry(scratch.dsn)==reg_after
  else:
   with pytest.raises((MigrationError,psycopg.IntegrityError)):
    with psycopg.connect(scratch.dsn) as c:apply_migrations(c)
   assert registry(scratch.dsn)==reg
  assert _snapshot_business_tables(scratch.dsn)==before
  with Path('/evidence/logs/migration-observations.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'base':base,'legal':legal,'all_seven_rows_equal':True,'old_full_registry_equal':True,'registry_rows':len(registry(scratch.dsn))})+'\n')
 finally:drop_scratch_database(namespace.base_dsn,scratch)
